_comment: Copy to data/accounts.json. One entry per bank account or card: an alias you choose, its type, and the last 4 digits only. bill_payment_pattern (cards) is a regex that picks out this card's bill payments in a bank statement. addons lists add-on cards on this card: their spending is yours, marked with the label. self_patterns pick out transfers between your own accounts (your name as banks print it); family_patterns pick out money sent to family. All values here are invented.
